admin.title: Administrator
admin.description: Sees everything and can make confirmed changes.

ops_manager.title: Operations manager
ops_manager.description: Runs day-to-day operations: orders, support, inventory, sellers and promotions, and reads the reports library. Can make confirmed changes.

analyst.title: Analyst
analyst.description: Reads the reports library for all regions. Cannot open operations pages or change data.

south_analyst.title: Analyst, South region
south_analyst.description: Reads the reports library for customers in the South region only. Cannot open operations pages or change data.
